description:
The Beckhoff.TwinCAT.Ads package includes everything to develop own .NET applications (e.g. visualization, scientific automation) for communication with TwinCAT devices (e.g. PLC, NC or IO-devices).
Root object is the AdsClient to communicate to all variants of local and remote ADS servers and devices.
releaseNotes:
Version 7.0.449

Fix: A 64-bit process couldn't connect to a local TwinCAT 2.11 x64 Engineering router since 7.0.280 (ClientPortNotOpen), #351526

Version 7.0.447

Fix: The resurrection of an AdsClient after a TwinCAT restart threw a NullReferenceException in an unobserved task when a cached handle was released or rejected meanwhile, #350618

Version 7.0.446

Fix: AdsSession could resume communication after a connection loss without resurrecting handles and notifications (and without counting TotalResurrections) when the access hit the end of the ResurrectionTime.

Version 7.0.442

BreakingChange: Requests that are pending when the local TwinCAT router reports Stopped or Removed are completed immediately with AdsErrorCode.PortDisabled instead of running into their timeout (ClientSyncTimeOut). Clients with the FailFast interceptor (default) reject new requests with PortDisabled until the router reports Started again, #349831

Version 7.0.428

Fix: AdsTimeoutSetter instances that overlap on a shared connection no longer leave it with a temporary timeout; the original timeout is restored by the last active setter.

Version 7.0.410

Fix: A client attached to its own AMS router no longer rejects the confirmation of a request it addressed to AmsNetId.LocalHost. The confirmation source is matched against the AmsNetId that client's own router assigned at AMS port registration, instead of against the process wide AmsNetId.Local, #338077

Version 7.0.403

Enh: Added the AdsClient.RouterState / AdsConnection.RouterState property reporting the last known state of the local AMS router, #337368

Fix: The RouterStateChanged event is raised with AmsRouterState.Removed again when the TwinCAT System Service is stopped, #337369

Version 7.0.382

Fix: Cached variable handles are dropped on all value accessors when the target reports them as stale, so value access recovers after a target restart, #333367

Version 7.0.370

Fix: The symbol loader no longer re-uploads the complete data type table on every access to the Namespaces and BuildInTypes properties, #333127, #333128

Enh: The symbol loader now logs every completed data type and symbol upload at Information level, including the number of entries, the transferred size and the target address

Fix: AdsClientSettings(int timeout) initialized a temporary object instead of the instance being constructed, so the timeout argument was ignored and the client silently used 5000 ms without the default FailFast interceptor, #333207

Fix: Symbol and data type uploads no longer fail during connect when the client has a short timeout (e.g. 200 ms); they use the configured connection timeout, #333208

Version 7.0.361

Fix: The symbol loader no longer re-reads the SymbolUploadInfo from the target on every asynchronous access, halving the number of upload info requests per symbol load, #333053

Version 7.0.355

Fix: AdsClient no longer accepts an ADS confirmation that originates from a different target than the one it is connected to, #332724

Fix: InvokeIDs are now unique per process instead of per client instance, so two clients sharing an AMS port cannot produce colliding IDs, #332724

Enh: The AMS client port and target address are now part of the request timeout, request failure and confirmation warnings, so they can be attributed to a client instance without enabling Debug logging, #332724

Fix: Synchronous reads of a 'REFERENCE TO' symbol used the pointer size instead of the size of the referenced type, so ReadValue failed where ReadValueAsync succeeded, #332792

Version 7.0.342

Fix: Unregistering the AdsStateChanged notification no longer asserts when the target cannot be reached, #331880

Version 7.0.331

Fix: Members created from a bit data type (e.g. BitMappingType) keep their BitValue flag / IsBitType, so bit members of programmatically created StructTypes are packed, addressed and uploaded as bits, #328844

Fix: IMemberCollection.CalcSize() derives the collection size from the member offsets instead of summing the member sizes, so padding and bit packing are taken into account, #328844

Fix: StructType(name, baseType, fields) takes over the passed fields as aligned members instead of only deriving its size from them and leaving Members empty. Members that are already aligned within another type are rejected with an ArgumentException, #328844

Version 7.0.306

Fix: Hardened the symbol and datatype upload parser against malformed or malicious upload blocks. Excessively nested datatype entries, invalid entry lengths and inconsistent sub-entry counts are now rejected instead of terminating the process with a StackOverflowException or looping endlessly, #321938

Enh: The raw SumCommands SumRead, SumWrite and SumReadWrite (ReadRaw/WriteRaw/ReadWriteRaw) are now documented API, every SumCommand offers a static Create(connection) factory returning a fluent builder, and SumInstancePathAnyTypeRead.ReadRaw/ReadRawAsync was added, #322397

BreakingChange: Renamed the SumCommand entity types to the Entry vocabulary already used by SumHandleEntry (e.g. SumDataEntity -> SumDataEntry, IgIoSumReadEntity -> IgIoSumReadEntry). All affected types are marked with EditorBrowsable(Never) and excluded from the documentation, #322399

Fix: Corrected several SumCommand defects: truncated device responses fail with a DeviceInvalidSize AdsErrorException instead of an ArgumentOutOfRangeException, SumReadWrite supports IndexGroup/IndexOffset entries in the discrete fallback mode, the SumRead constructors taking a list of IgIoSumReadEntry no longer throw an InvalidCastException, SumHandleReadAnyType keeps the configured string length, and SumAnyTypeRead.Read2 no longer fails with a MarshalException in the discrete fallback mode, #322397

Version 7.0.286

Fix: SumReadWrite (ReadWriteList) result parser now validates per-result lengths from the server response against the remaining reply buffer and the client-requested size before slicing. A malicious or tampered server can no longer cause an uncaught exception or desync the result offset.

Version 7.0.280

Fix: Issue starting communication with 32-Bit TwinCAT (hanging on TcpLoopback)

Version 7.0.270

Fix: IAdsSymbolLoader.Dispose() throws InvalidCastException (https://github.com/Beckhoff/TF6000_ADS_DOTNET_V5_Samples/issues/82), #310022

Version 7.0.265

Enh: Added support for PouType attribute. Types with PouType=FunctionBlock are now categorized as DataTypeCategory.FunctionBlock, types with PouType=Program as DataTypeCategory.Program instead of DataTypeCategory.Struct.

Version 7.0.176

Fix: Cancelling an asynchronous request returned AdsErrorCode.ClientSyncTimeOut instead of AdsErrorCode.ClientRequestCancelled and put the connection into the Lost state, #87802, #314577

Version 7.0.165

Enh: IEnumValue.Value replaces IEnumValue.Primitive and IEnumValue.BaseType replaces IEnumValue.ManagedBaseType; the old properties are obsolete

Fix: Error "Object must implement IConvertible" on symbolic reading of PLC Enum types via IValueSymbol.ReadValue().

Version 7.0.156

Enh: AdsClient.IsConnected no longer blocks while Connect/Disconnect is running, #286141

Version 7.0.152

Enh: AdsClient.Connect() fails after a timeout instead of hanging when the AMS router doesn't answer

Enh: AdsClient.ConnectAsync no longer blocks a thread

Version 7.0.145

Fix: IValueSymbol.WriteValue(object value) throws SymbolException with AdsErrorCode.None

Version 7.0.140

Enh: SumHandleReadAnyType and SumHandleWriteAnyType replace SumHandleRead and SumHandleWrite, which remain available

Version 7.0.127

Fix: Fixes Double ADS Notifications on Symbol objects when AdsClient.ReadSymbol() is used in combination with the symbol loader on the same Symbol, #280709

Version 7.0.109

Enh: Fewer memory allocations and copy operations for better performance

Version 7.0.100

Fix: Calculating all overloads of an IStructType inheritance tree could lead into KeyAlreadyAddedException in IStructType.AllMembers, #274903

Enh: Implementation of TwinCAT.Ads.SumCommand.SumAddNotifications and TwinCAT.Ads.SumCommand.SumDeleteNotifications

Enh: Discrete Fallbacks for SumCommands if SumCommands are not supported.

Version 7.0.90

Enh: Adds Notification Statistics to AdsSession.Statistics.

Version 7.0.86

Enh: Several new AdsClient, AdsConnection overloads that take the instancePath string as parameter to Access 'ValueByName'

Enh: Better performance with AdsClient.Disconnect / AdsClient.Dispose methods, #270737

Version 7.0.79

Fix: AdsClient doesn't remove the Variable Handle from HandleCache when calling TryDeleteDeviceNotification, DeleteDeviceNotificationAsync, #269484

Version 7.0.74

Fix: Race condition in SymbolCache and HandleCache accessing handles from seperate Threads, https://github.com/Beckhoff/TF6000_ADS_DOTNET_V5_Samples/issues/76

Version 7.0.60

Fix: Use Encoding.Unicode for marshalling RpcInvoke return values of type WSTRING.

Fix: WString marshalling of DynamicSymbol.TrySetMemberValue

Version 7.0.36

BreakingChange: Removed the net6.0 target (.NET 6 is out of support)

Version 7.0.25

Fix: Cannot access symbol that is an alias type to a jagged array, fixes #197676, #171438

Version 7.0.10

Fix: Fixes to write ReferenceTypes via IValueSymbol.WriteValue() or IValueSymbol.WriteValueAsync(), #256269

Version 7.0

Enh: Using ValueAccessMode.InstancePath for IValueSymbol.ReadValue() / IValueSymbol.WriteValue() instead of 3 roundtrips via ADS handles.

Enh: Supports locally installed TwinCAT 2 (via PInvoke channel). The fallback to 'TcAmsServer.dll' also enables systems without an open TCP loopback port (e.g. TC2 or TCP loopback disabled), #230847

Enh: Supports internal communication via UnixSockets, TCP/IP Loopback and PInvoke

Enh: TargetFramework dependencies changed to net8.0, net6.0, netstandard2.0
